summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 30, 2026, solely to notify that its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 was filed. The filing includes no M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation event; it is a routine disclosure obligation for a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or advisors are mentioned. The submission is purely administrative, so it does not constitute a special situation under event-driven research criteria.
